prompt:
Make a professional CUTOUT ANIMATION PART ATLAS derived faithfully from the attached existing master character. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, costume, material colors, weapon ornaments and long slender 4.5–5-head body proportion. This is the SAME person's connected anatomy separated for articulated animation, not independent redesigned items.
Canvas1536x1024 landscape, TRUE transparent RGBA. Precise SIX equal columns by THREE equal rows; exactly one independently painted part per cell, each FULLY INSIDE its own cell with minimum24px transparent clearance on all four sides. Uniformly scale each item down to fit, keep native aspect ratio. Absolutely no neighboring overlap, labels, text, grid lines, cast shadows or complete assembled person.
All limb parts in a neutral downward anatomical orientation: proximal end at TOP, distal at BOTTOM. Upper arms include their one shoulder ornament; chest has NO shoulder ornaments. Arm wrist ends are plain closed material, not holes or cylindrical cuffs. Head is the COMPLETE intact face and FRONT hair plus short BARE neck, no duplicate clothing collar. Torso is one continuous collar-to-hip core with chest, belt and SHORT FRONT costume piece but NO arms, NO legs, no big trailing robe panels. Legs must be LONG slim hip-to-knee and knee-to-ankle segments, not squat chibi. Knee ornament appears only ONCE at bottom of each thigh; shins are plain lower-leg continuation. Feet are complete normal shoes with SHORT ankle overlap, no exaggerated tubes. Hands separate from weapons: no hand fragments painted onto weapon; gloves at rest gently curled around an imagined grip.
EXACT row-major order:
ROW1: 1 whole intact head/front hair; 2 rear hair excluding face; 3 continuous torso+waist+short front garment; 4 flowing BACK CAPE/trailing garment cloth only; 5 primary weapon ONLY; 6 secondary equipment ONLY.
ROW2: 1 ANATOMICAL LEFT upper arm (seen on viewerRIGHT); 2 LEFT forearm; 3 LEFT hand; 4 ANATOMICAL RIGHT upper arm (viewerLEFT); 5 RIGHT forearm; 6 RIGHT hand.
ROW3: 1 LEFT thigh; 2 LEFT shin; 3 LEFT foot; 4 RIGHT thigh; 5 RIGHT shin; 6 RIGHT foot.
Feet point gently outward in the frontal three-quarter master style. Flesh/clothing must form natural overlapping PAINTED connections when joined; no black sockets, no outlined mechanical joints.
HERO-SPECIFIC: Elisia: leaf-and-green-jewel nature STAFF upright in anatomical LEFT hand(viewerRIGHT), grasp point two thirds down shaft. Row1col6 a small nature light charm only. Preserve white hair, greeneyes, white/green/gold priest garments. Separate flowing rear robe panels into row1col4; short front core ends at upper thigh so the master long legs remain visible. Hands: left gently curled staff grip, right open casting palm.
